contract.name: Super Bowl week
contract.text: The Super Bowl is in Dallas this year and the host committee needs coaches. They want daily service into Dallas from Houston, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City and Memphis for the fortnight around the game. Hold every one of those routes for the whole period and the committee pays a $1,200,000 bonus.

contract.name: Film crew charter
contract.text: A studio is shooting in the desert and wants one coach to take the crew from Los Angeles to Las Vegas and keep them together. They are paying well for a dedicated run, and they want the good seats.

contract.name: State fair shuttle
contract.text: The state fair in Minneapolis runs for twelve days and the fair board wants coaches from Milwaukee, Chicago, Omaha and Kansas City for all of it. Keep every route running and the board pays a $450,000 bonus.
